detailed_insights.headline: Malt Up spread by word of mouth faster than shops stocked it, so buyers went looking in small shops
detailed_insights.whats_happening: Munchee Malt Up launched on 10 July at Havelock City with Cargills. Buyers say they saw no ad and heard about it through comments and friends. Supermarkets didn't have it and small shops hadn't stocked it, so some waited for the Munchee van or asked shopkeepers to keep a pack. Four signals describe the same search.
detailed_insights.why_it_matters: It's rare for buyers to go looking for a new biscuit. Every empty small-shop shelf in that period was a lost sale, and small-shop owners are central to Munchee's distribution.

what_to_do.action: Get Malt Up into small shops in the 20 towns with the most Malt Up mentions, with a counter display and a 'now in stock' sticker
Change the Munchee van routine so new products reach small shops in the first week, not only supermarkets
Reply to the creators who posted about searching for it, saying where to buy it now

detailed_insights.if_you_dont_act: Interest fades before stock arrives, and people remember Malt Up as the biscuit they couldn't find.

detailed_insights.headline: Fans call the Super Cream Cracker 'the GOAT' on their own, while 'Life's Hunger' posts get no replies
detailed_insights.whats_happening: A meme account calls the plain cracker 'the one and only' and pairs it with pol sambol, Nutella, cheese and curry in a 'best duo' series; home cooks fry it into cutlets. Munchee's 'Life's Hunger' posts on the Super Cream Cracker page ask followers to comment about their struggles and, in the data, get no consumer replies. 67% of Munchee posts come from consumers rather than the brand or sellers.
detailed_insights.why_it_matters: The most popular cracker content is made by fans, about food pairings and childhood memories, not about ambition. 'Life's Hunger' isn't connecting with how people actually talk about the cracker.

what_to_do.action: Start a 'best duo' series based on the fan format: one pairing a week, crediting the fan, in Sinhala and English
Change 'Life's Hunger' from asking for comments to sharing real fan posts and recipes
Track the share of Munchee posts that come from consumers every month

detailed_insights.if_you_dont_act: Fan enthusiasm for the cracker goes unused, and 'Life's Hunger' stays a slogan.

detailed_insights.headline: Tikiri Marie's 'A child, not just a winner' campaign fits the O/L season, but only broadcasters are sharing it
detailed_insights.whats_happening: The 'Unusual Exam' for World Children's Day asks parents to ask 'were you happy today?' instead of 'what rank did you get?'. Posts come from Munchee/CBL, Swarnavahini, Sirasa and news pages; no parents have posted their own reactions yet. The 2026 O/L exam runs 8–17 December, and parents worry daily about what to put in lunch boxes.
detailed_insights.why_it_matters: The message suits exam season. Without parents sharing it, it stays a PR story, and the chance to link it to exam-time lunch boxes passes.

what_to_do.action: Invite parents to share 'what's in the O/L lunch box' with Tikiri Marie, 1–17 December
Give the campaign film to school and parent pages, not only TV channels

detailed_insights.if_you_dont_act: People remember the campaign as a TV clip, and Maliban's factory-tour game gets children's attention instead.

early_signs.text: Parents worry about lunch boxes daily

signals.title: Tikiri Marie's 'Unusual Exam' is carried by broadcasters and Munchee pages, not parents
signals.what_we_see: Coverage of the Children's Day campaign comes from Munchee/CBL, Swarnavahini, Sirasa and news pages. Few parents post their own reactions.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The message fits parents' worries, but it needs parent voices to travel beyond PR.

signals.title: Tikiri Marie's 'Unusual Exam' circulates through PR and influencers
signals.what_we_see: All posts describe the same Ape Gama event for World Children's Day: painting, clay and performance instead of ranked exams, with campaign hashtags.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Strong message, but no organic parent posts yet; prompt parents to share before the O/L.

signals.title: Parents at the Tikiri Marie event welcomed play over ranking, but few others are posting
signals.what_we_see: Most posts come from Munchee/CBL, TV and news. Parents filmed at the event said they welcomed children playing and painting instead of competing for marks.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Use the parents' own words from the event in the next push.

signals.title: Parents worry children will reject repetitive lunch boxes and add treats to make sure they eat
signals.what_we_see: Posts are mostly from outside Sri Lanka. Parents hunt for new lunch combinations, add small sweet treats so the box isn't returned uneaten, and personalise boxes with names and themes.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: A biscuit as the 'treat that gets the lunch box eaten' is a strong parent message if it shows up in Sri Lankan posts.
signals.evidence_scope: global pattern, no Sri Lankan post

signals.title: A mother reshapes refused foods into fun lunch box items for her toddler
signals.what_we_see: 'Life with MD' turns chickpeas into fries and sweet potato into patties, with star-cut fruit and cute forks.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Parents need help making lunch boxes appealing; Munchee can offer ideas.

signals.title: Adults say today's children have lost outdoor play, and that exams matter less than play
signals.what_we_see: Commentators compare their own outdoor childhoods with today's, saying children no longer recognise a mango leaf and that play matters more than exams.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: This is the feeling Tikiri Marie's 'A child, not just a winner' campaign taps; it can draw on these adult voices.

early_topics.what_we_see: Munchee promoted Chocolate Puff at music events; no consumer posts.

signals.title: Adults say today's children have lost outdoor play, and that exams matter less than play
signals.what_we_see: Commentators compare their own outdoor childhoods with today's, saying children no longer recognise a mango leaf and that play matters more than exams.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: This is the feeling Tikiri Marie's 'A child, not just a winner' campaign taps; it can draw on these adult voices.

signals.title: Malt Up buyers film taste tests and judge the price, pack count and chocolate coating
signals.what_we_see: Buyers bought Malt Up because it was trending, then filmed taste tests. They preferred the Choco variant but pointed to Rs. 180–190 for 10–11 biscuits and chocolate on only one side.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Value is judged on camera; Malt Up's pack count and coating are the first things to fix.

signals.title: Tikiri Marie's 'Unusual Exam' is carried by broadcasters and Munchee pages, not parents
signals.what_we_see: Coverage of the Children's Day campaign comes from Munchee/CBL, Swarnavahini, Sirasa and news pages. Few parents post their own reactions.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The message fits parents' worries, but it needs parent voices to travel beyond PR.

signals.title: Home cooks turn cream crackers into fried cutlets in recipe videos
signals.what_we_see: Two creators posted nearly identical recipes: spiced potato and fish between crackers, crumbed and deep-fried.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Super Cream Cracker is a recipe ingredient as well as a snack; recipe content is free promotion.

signals.title: Buyers found Malt Up through friends, not ads, and hunted small shops for it
signals.what_we_see: Several buyers said they saw no ad. Supermarkets had none, so they checked small shops, waited for the Munchee van or asked shopkeepers to keep packs. Opinions were mixed: 'addictive' vs 'average', with 11 biscuits for about Rs. 180.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Malt Up demand outran distribution; small-shop stock is the gap to close.

signals.title: Tikiri Marie's 'Unusual Exam' circulates through PR and influencers
signals.what_we_see: All posts describe the same Ape Gama event for World Children's Day: painting, clay and performance instead of ranked exams, with campaign hashtags.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Strong message, but no organic parent posts yet; prompt parents to share before the O/L.

signals.title: Small shops didn't stock Malt Up, so buyers called ahead or had family bring it
signals.what_we_see: People heard about Malt Up in comments and feeds, then looked for it nearby; small retailers hadn't stocked it because it was unknown. Some ate most of the pack in one go.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Push Malt Up into small shops and tell shopkeepers before customers ask.

signals.title: Parents at the Tikiri Marie event welcomed play over ranking, but few others are posting
signals.what_we_see: Most posts come from Munchee/CBL, TV and news. Parents filmed at the event said they welcomed children playing and painting instead of competing for marks.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Use the parents' own words from the event in the next push.

signals.title: Sri Lankans remake the 'best duo' meme with cream crackers and local dishes
signals.what_we_see: A meme account turns the 'best duo' format into cream crackers with chicken curry, pol sambol or Happy Cow cheese, with each video answering a follower's suggestion.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: A ready-made, fan-led format Munchee can join or repost.

signals.title: People treat tea with Lemon Puff as a calming daily moment
signals.what_we_see: Posts frame hot milk tea and Lemon Puff as comfort, with steam, candlelight and nostalgia.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Lemon Puff owns a tea-break moment; lean into it in office and home content.

signals.title: Adults repost an old Munchee ad and ask 'who remembers this?'
signals.what_we_see: People share a classic biscuit commercial with 90s-kids and 2000s-nostalgia tags, with crying-heart emojis.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Old Munchee ads are loved; a 'throwback' series would get engagement.

signals.title: Meme creators praise the Munchee cream cracker as better than fancy cookies
signals.what_we_see: Video edits call the cream cracker 'the GOAT' and show other cookies as 'wasted', with the Munchee pack shown by name.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Fans tie the love to the Munchee brand, not just crackers in general.

signals.title: Meme edits hype the cream cracker like a sports star
signals.what_we_see: Edits call the cream cracker 'THE GOAT' and 'THE ONE AND ONLY', showing the Munchee pack.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Same fan energy as signals 20, 25 and 33.

signals.title: Biscuit pudding is trending as a cheap comfort dessert
signals.what_we_see: Creators show ready-made biscuit pudding (Rs. 140 at Keells) and share home recipes because viewers ask for them.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Marie is the base of biscuit pudding; a Munchee Marie pudding recipe would fit.

signals.title: Recipe pages publish copycat versions of Munchee Rollz
signals.what_we_see: Pages post near-identical wafer-stick recipes in 5–6 flavours, framed as cheaper, cleaner versions of Rollz, with a no-oven method. Nobody reports making them.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Rollz's price is being noticed; a smaller, cheaper pack could answer it.

signals.title: Creators all film the same Munchee Savoury football box routine
signals.what_we_see: Creators open the hexagon box, pour in sachets, add sauce and mayonnaise and mix, repeating the Rs. 300 price and the same delivery apps and shops.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The scripted format reached people but reads as paid; organic follow-up is missing.

signals.title: The Munchee Savoury football box spread through one copied mixing format
signals.what_we_see: Creators repeat the same preparation, the Rs. 300 price and delivery claims; it reads as campaign output.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The box got attention during the World Cup but didn't spark organic demand.

signals.title: Munchee's 'Life's Hunger' posts ask for comments and get none
signals.what_we_see: All posts use the Sinhala phrase 'ජීවිතේ බඩගින්න' and ask followers to comment their struggles. No consumer replies appear.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The platform isn't sparking conversation; fan-led content works better.

signals.title: Home cooks post step-by-step cream cracker cutlet recipes in Sinhala
signals.what_we_see: Creators show the full recipe with viral hashtags and invite viewers to try it.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Cream cracker recipes are a content opportunity for Munchee.

signals.title: Followers suggest cream cracker pairings and a creator turns each into a video
signals.what_we_see: The 'best duo' format crowns cream crackers with Sri Lankan dishes suggested in the comments.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Fans are building the brand's content for it.

signals.title: Recipe publishers copy filled wafer sticks as a cheap home snack
signals.what_we_see: Authors repeat the same six-flavour recipe, justified on cost and cleanliness versus the packaged brand.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Same as signal 42.

signals.title: Creators crown local food pairings in the 'best duo' meme
signals.what_we_see: Cream crackers with pol sambol, meat curry or Happy Cow cheese win over cookie-and-milk.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Same as signals 25 and 56.

signals.title: Black Edition's buzz comes from fashion-show placements, not consumers
signals.what_we_see: Most posts are brand or partner content: a mother–daughter fashion show (58,138 engagements on one reel) and a World Chocolate Day contest. Little organic talk.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Black Edition needs real people tasting and talking, as Kriollo has.

signals.title: Sinhala home cooks call homemade wafer sticks cleaner and cheaper than Rollz
signals.what_we_see: Recipes share the same tip, roll the batter hot, and explicitly compare to Rollz.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Same as signal 42.

signals.title: A buyer went to a shop she usually avoids to find Malt Up
signals.what_we_see: Supermarkets didn't stock Malt Up, so buyers turned to small shops; one called her son to fetch packs, and shopkeepers promised to source more.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Same as signals 13 and 16: distribution is the gap.

signals.title: Black Edition's World Chocolate Day push was fully brand-run
signals.what_we_see: All posts repeat the same tagline and hashtags, with slow-motion chocolate shots and a UGC contest.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Same as signal 66.

signals.title: Recipe creators flood feeds with five-biscuit pudding variations
signals.what_we_see: Creators post coffee, Milo and caramel pudding versions with few ingredients.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Biscuit pudding is a Marie occasion; Munchee can supply the recipe.

signals.title: Cream crackers are used as a cheap base for fried snacks
signals.what_we_see: Creators sandwich spiced fillings between crackers, crumb and fry them, using everyday pantry items.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Same as signals 12 and 54.

signals.title: A user reposted an old Tikiri Marie ad asking who remembers it
signals.what_we_see: A classic Tikiri Marie commercial was reposted twice with teary-heart emojis and 90s nostalgia tags.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Tikiri Marie's old ads carry emotional weight; a throwback could support the current campaign.

signals.title: The CBL chairman's death led people to list the Munchee brands in every home
signals.what_we_see: Mourners named Munchee, Ritzbury, Thriposha and Samaposha as household staples and praised Thriposha's role against child malnutrition.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: CBL's heritage and nutrition story resonates; it isn't being told beyond moments like this.

signals.title: A diaspora creator reviews Sri Lankan snacks, including Hawaiian Cookies
signals.what_we_see: A snack-review series uses Sri Lankan hashtags and Sinhala tags, framing snacks as cultural identity.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Diaspora buyers are an export audience for Munchee classics.

signals.title: 'Life's Hunger' posts adapt to rain and Mother's Day but still get no replies
signals.what_we_see: Every post uses the same phrase and ends with a call to comment; no organic comments appear.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Same as signal 53.

signals.title: Adults bond over remembering the old Tikiri Marie ad
signals.what_we_see: People reshare the 1990s/2000s Tikiri Marie commercial and ask who remembers it.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Same as signal 82.

signals.title: People mourned the CBL chairman by naming the brands on every shelf
signals.what_we_see: Posts framed his legacy through Munchee, Ritzbury, Thriposha and Samaposha, and exports to 60+ countries.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Same as signal 83.

signals.title: Adults still eat a childhood date cake with tea
signals.what_we_see: People describe Little Lion date cake as a childhood favourite now eaten with tea and packed in children's lunch boxes.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Childhood biscuit habits carry into adult tea time.

signals.title: A diaspora creator's snack reviews link Colombo and Boston
signals.what_we_see: A Sri Lankan Snack Review series uses Sinhala and English tags from both cities.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Same as signal 84.

signals.title: People mourned the CBL chairman as a model of principled local industry
signals.what_we_see: Posts praised him as a hands-on leader and highlighted Thriposha's child-nutrition work.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Same as signal 83.

signals.title: Britannia's festival hampers are unboxed by gifted creators
signals.what_we_see: Posts are mostly from outside Sri Lanka. Nepali creators opened Britannia hampers and thanked the brand.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Gifted hampers create unboxing content; useful for Christmas and Avurudu.

sample_report.question: Should Munchee change the Malt Up pack (10–11 biscuits at Rs. 180–190), given buyers' complaints about value?
sample_report.sources_searched: Forevate signals and posts (export), public cost data
sample_report.summary: Keep the price and add more biscuits or more chocolate. Buyers tried Malt Up because it was trending and liked the taste, but their videos pointed to three value problems: 10–11 biscuits, chocolate on one side, and no noticeable energy boost. Flour went up Rs. 17/kg in August, so a cheaper pack is unlikely; a better pack at the same price answers the complaints without a shrinking-pack story.

signal_index.title: Adults say today's children have lost outdoor play, and that exams matter less than play
signal_index.what_we_see: Commentators compare their own outdoor childhoods with today's, saying children no longer recognise a mango leaf and that play matters more than exams.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: This is the feeling Tikiri Marie's 'A child, not just a winner' campaign taps; it can draw on these adult voices.

signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Students want cheap, filling, shareable food; a campus value pack would fit.

signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: A biscuit as the 'treat that gets the lunch box eaten' is a strong parent message if it shows up in Sri Lankan posts.
